newsitem.title: USA: New products from Knox, Kraft and Curad.
newsitem.headline: New products from Knox, Kraft and Curad.

text.p: This week's new products include a new dietary supplement from Knox Co., a "lite" version of a 60-year-old standard from Kraft Foods and some new bandages to take the ouch away, from Curad.
The Knox Co., a unit of Nabisco Holdings, has developed a new dietary supplement, a gelatine-based product to help maintain healthy joint cartilage and strong bones.

Knox NutraJoint is a powder that contains specific amino acids and calcium to help the body maintain strong bones. It is designed for people who have joint stress due to vigorous physical activity or excess weight, or whose joints are experiencing wear and tear as part of growing older.
Knox NutraJoint is a flavorless powder that dissolves in hot or cold beverages such as coffee or orange juice.
According to the company's promotional materials, based on clinical studies, people who consume one 12-gram scoop of Knox NutraJoint each day may begin to notice results in as little as two months.

For more information, call 1-800-KNOX-GEL (566--9435) or contact the Web site at http://www.knoxgel.com. A free brochure is available by calling the 800 number or writing to The Knox Co., P.O. Box 303, Parsippany, N.J., 07054-0303.
Knox NutraJoint comes in re-sealable 6-1/8-ounce canisters (174 g), enough for 14-days. It has a suggested retail price of $6.99 to $8.99.

Curad, maker of trademarked "ouchless" bandages, has developed a new line designed to help heal minor burns and blisters -- Advanced Curad's Blister-Care, Cool-Wrap for burns, Sof-Gel and Aqua-Protect.
Blister-Care is created just for blisters and uses a water-based gel on the sterilised pads.
Sof-Gel is designed for cuts and scrapes also has water-based gel technology and seals wounds to minimise infection.
Cool-Wrap for Burns contains gel to sooth burns and promote healing. Aqua Protect is a waterproof and breathable bandage that can stay on even under water.
The bandages cost from $3.89 to $4.49 and are being introduced nationwide.
For a free sample, send a stamped self-addressed envelope to G.S.Schwartz & Co., Attn. Advanced Curad, 470 Park Ave. South, 10th floor, New York, N.Y. 10016. - - - -

Kraft Foods Inc., celebrating the 60th anniversary of its Macaroni & Cheese, is introducing Kraft Light Deluxe Macaroni & Cheese, containing 50 percent less fat and 10 percent fewer calories than the original.
Light Deluxe is made with reduced-fat cheeses. It has 290 calories and 4.5 grams of fat per serving.
The new Kraft macaroni mix will be distributed nationally begining in April. It will be sold in 14-ounce boxes, containing four one-cup servings.
It has a suggested retail price of $1.99.
For the over 23 million 15- to 24-year-olds who are currently employed full- or part-time, tax time applies to them, too.
Anyone who earns more than $4,000 or has unearned income totalling $650 or more (such as interest), or has a combined earned and unearned income over $650, is reqired by law to file a tax return.
If this young person has earned less than $4,000 in the past year, he or she might be due a refund from the government.

To answer many questions about tax filing for teens and young adults, Citibank has a free brochure especially for teenagers, "Tax Facts for First-Time Filers." It is available by calling 1-800-669-2635.
